title: Clinical Professor of Law
bio: Sabrineh Ardalan is a clinical professor of law and director of the Harvard Immigration and Refugee Clinical Program. At the program, Ardalan supervises and trains law students engaged in deportation defense, district court and appellate litigation, and policy advocacy.
